Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot incident in
Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the basics, but sure. It's the claimant here, the one who was driving the car.
Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened when the collision occurred?
A: I was pulling into a space near the store entrance. Another vehicle was backing out from the row arcoss from me,
and I didn't see it coming until it was already on my bumper. I hit my brakes, but there wasn't much room.
Q: How fast were you going when you were pulling in?
A: Walking speed, maybe a little faster. It's a parking lot, so nobody's really going fast.
Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?
A: Yeah, we swapped insurance details and took a few photos of the bumpers.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: Not right away. I was sore the next morning, mostly in my lower back. The pain got worse over a couple of days, so
I went to get checked out.
Q: What was the diagnosis from your doctor?
A: They said it was a back strain. I've been doing stretching exercises and taking it easy. I still get stiff when I sit too
long.
Q: Are you currently under any treatment?
A: I'm seeing a physical therapist twice a week. My doctor wants me to keep that up for a while.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with your lower back?
A: Nothing serious. I had some soreness years ago after moving furniture, but it went away on its own.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal. I'd appreciate it if this could move along.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
